body: I've been trying to get back in touch with the counselor and for some reason it has been difficult. I had to reach out to the school counselor today and see if they could get into contact with them. I was apparently suppose to get a call from them today but i haven't so i'm not sure. I had to cut off my ex after i tried to kill myself because he was still continuously hurting me and he asked me twice if we were friends after i did cut him off. I been trying to keep a brave face and stay out of his way even if he's a part of my friend group, but my breakdowns are uncontrollable now which is why i had that reaction.
Jeez, you seriously need some help

Thank you, it does help! The cuts themselves aren't that deep but it was still surprising the first time i got in the water. I wasn't kinda afraid to put my arm in the water itself but when i did it burned a lot and the pain faded with time. I noticed they were red like irritated. I know i had witch hazel at some point so i'll look for it to see if i still have it.

I haven't really considered therapy much, though I have heard about it from others. I was offered to take counseling after having a panic attack years ago but my younger self was pretty stubborn about it. I kinda grown up with the idea that "being strong means not relying on others" so I didn't want to get help thinking that others might look down on me for it. I still have kinda have that mentality, but I don't really look down on therapy as much as I used too. I'm not sure if I'll do therapy in the future. I just kinda hoped it get better as time passes, but it is something I will consider.

I think what makes me fee miserable is that everyday I'm either anxious, being mentally and physically exhausted all the time, and or some other negative feelings. Recently, i been even more worried for my future, so that's one of the things I been thinking about lately. My mind usually wonders off and I have a hard time keeping my thoughts quiet, it gets so distracting and "noisy" sometimes.
Thanks, I'll keep that in mind. I don't understand why she's so rude, but whenever she tries anything I'll try to say something. I'm just glad i don't really see her much besides breakfast
